					<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Contact Us — TiviOne Official IPTV</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Contact TiviOne Official IPTV — 24/7 support via WhatsApp, email or our contact form."/>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;1,9..40,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css"/>
  <style>
    *,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
    :root{
      --bg:#000000;--bg-2:#030305;--bg-3:#060610;
      --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--border-hi:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
      --text:#F5F2FF;--muted:#9490B0;--soft:#CCC8E2;
      --cyan:#40CFFF;--violet:#7B5CFF;--pink:#F040C8;
      --grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#38D0FF 0%,#8040E0 40%,#F030C8 75%,#FF6830 100%);
      --grad-soft:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.09),rgba(123,92,255,.11),rgba(240,64,200,.08));
      --r-xl:24px;--r-lg:18px;--r-md:12px;--r-pill:999px;
      --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      --shadow-lg:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.38);
    }
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
    body{
      font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 8% 12%,rgba(64,207,255,.10) 0%,transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 38% at 90% 10%,rgba(240,64,200,.09) 0%,transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 55% 92%,rgba(123,92,255,.13) 0%,transparent 100%),
        linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg-2) 55%,var(--bg-3) 100%);
      min-height:100vh;color:var(--text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
    @keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes shimmer{0%{left:-100%}100%{left:200%}}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    @keyframes pulseRing{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(64,207,255,.35)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(64,207,255,0)}}
    @keyframes flashHighlight{0%{background:rgba(64,207,255,.18);border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.6)}100%{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}}

    /* ── NAVBAR ── */
    .navbar{
      position:sticky;top:0;left:0;right:0;width:100%;height:60px;z-index:9999;
      background:rgba(4,4,12,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }
    .navbar-inner{
      height:100%;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
    }
    .nv-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0;}
    .nv-logo-icon{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:.85rem;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(123,92,255,.30);}
    .nv-logo-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;line-height:1.1;}
    .nv-logo-name b{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .nv-logo-sub{font-size:.60rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;}
    .nv-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;flex:1;justify-content:center;}
    .nv-links a{
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:7px;
      text-decoration:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;
      transition:all .18s ease;white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .nv-links a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);}
    .nv-links a.active{color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(64,207,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.18);}
    .nv-links svg{width:13px;height:13px;opacity:.6;flex-shrink:0;}
    .nv-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;}
    .nv-btn{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:34px;padding:0 14px;
      border-radius:7px;border:none;cursor:pointer;
      font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;
      text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s ease;
    }
    .nv-btn-wa{background:rgba(37,211,102,.15);border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.25);color:#4ade80;cursor:pointer;}
    .nv-btn-wa:hover{background:rgba(37,211,102,.22);color:#86efac;}
    /* "Contact Us" button in header → scrolls to form */
    .nv-btn-contact{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(128,64,224,.30);}
    .nv-btn-contact:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px);}
    .nv-ham{
      display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .nv-ham-icon{width:18px;height:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none;}
    .nv-ham-line{display:block;width:100%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#fff;transition:all .25s ease;transform-origin:center;}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6px) rotate(45deg);}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg);}
    .nv-drawer{
      position:fixed;top:60px;left:0;right:0;
      background:rgba(4,4,14,.99);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:12px 16px 16px;z-index:9998;
      transform:translateY(-10px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .25s ease,opacity .25s ease;
    }
    .nv-drawer.open{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;pointer-events:all;}
    .nv-drawer-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:12px;}
    .nv-drawer-link{
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:9px;
      text-decoration:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);
      font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .18s ease;cursor:pointer;
    }
    .nv-drawer-link:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff;}
    .nv-drawer-link.active{background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);color:var(--cyan);}
    .nv-drawer-link svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.6;}
    .nv-drawer-div{height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);margin:8px 0;}
    .nv-drawer-btns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}
    .nv-drawer-btn{height:42px;border-radius:9px;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s ease;}
    .nv-drawer-btn-wa{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#25D366,#128C7E);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;}
    .nv-drawer-btn-contact{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;}
    @media(max-width:900px){.nv-links,.nv-btn-wa{display:none;}.nv-ham{display:flex;}}

    /* ══ NAVBAR MOBILE FIX ══ */
    .navbar{background:rgba(4,4,12,.98)!important}
    .navbar-inner{padding:0 16px!important;gap:8px!important}
    .nv-ham{
      display:none;
      width:36px!important;height:36px!important;min-width:36px!important;
      border-radius:8px!important;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;
      border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)!important;
      align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      flex-shrink:0!important;padding:0!important;
      cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease;
    }
    .nv-ham:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important}
    .nv-ham-icon{width:16px!important;height:12px!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}
    .nv-ham-line{display:block;width:100%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#ffffff!important;transition:all .25s ease;transform-origin:center}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(5px) rotate(45deg)}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(2){opacity:0;transform:scaleX(0)}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-45deg)}
    .nv-drawer{
      background:rgba(4,6,18,.99)!important;
      backdrop-filter:blur(24px)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px)!important;
    }
    .nv-drawer-link{
      color:rgba(255,255,255,.80)!important;
      font-size:.92rem!important;
      padding:13px 14px!important;
      border:1px solid transparent;
    }
    .nv-drawer-link:hover{color:#fff!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important}
    .nv-drawer-link.active{color:var(--cyan)!important;background:rgba(64,207,255,.08)!important;border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.15)!important}
    .nv-drawer-btn{height:46px!important;font-size:.90rem!important;font-weight:700!important}
    .nv-drawer-btn-wa{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(37,211,102,.25)!important}
    .nv-drawer-btn-order{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(123,92,255,.28)!important}
    @media(max-width:900px){
      .nv-links,.nv-btn-wa{display:none!important}
      .nv-ham{display:flex!important}
    }
    @media(max-width:600px){
      .nv-ham{display:flex!important}
      .nv-logo-sub{display:none!important}
      .nv-btn-order{padding:0 10px!important;font-size:.74rem!important;height:30px!important}
      .navbar-inner{padding:0 12px!important}
    }
    @media(max-width:380px){
      .nv-logo-name{font-size:.82rem!important}
      .nv-logo-icon{width:28px!important;height:28px!important}
    }

    /* ══ OFFICIAL BAR FIX ══ */
      width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;
      background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;
      color:#fff;font-size:.55rem;flex-shrink:0;
      box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(123,92,255,.35);
    }
      font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;
      letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
      background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    @media(min-width:640px){.official-bar-sep-hide{display:block}}
    @media(max-width:480px){
    }

    /* ══ GLOBAL MOBILE FIXES ══ */
    @media(max-width:600px){
      /* Modal */
      .modal-overlay{padding:8px!important}
      .modal{border-radius:16px!important;max-height:96vh!important}
      .modal-head{padding:16px 16px 12px!important}
      .modal-body{padding:14px!important}
      .payment-grid{gap:5px!important}
      .contact-choice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
      .contact-btn-badge{display:none!important}
      .form-input,.form-select{height:42px!important;font-size:.85rem!important}
    }

    @media(max-width:460px){.navbar-inner{padding:0 14px;}.nv-logo-sub{font-size:.52rem;}.nv-logo-icon{width:28px;height:28px;}.nv-logo-name{font-size:.88rem;}}

    /* ── PAGE HERO ── */
    .page-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:72px 6% 80px;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;}
    .page-hero::before{
      content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;
      background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);
      background-size:38px 38px;
      mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.6),transparent 100%);
    }
    .hero-glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:900px;height:500px;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(123,92,255,.18) 0%,rgba(240,64,200,.11) 45%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(40px);}
    .page-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.20);color:rgba(150,225,255,.90);font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:24px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .05s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-eyebrow-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan);animation:blink 2.2s infinite;}
    .page-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .12s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-title .plain{color:var(--text);}
    .page-title .grad{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .page-sub{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.82;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;max-width:52ch;margin:0 auto 36px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .20s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-breadcrumb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);opacity:0;animation:up .5s .26s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-breadcrumb a{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none;}
    .page-breadcrumb i{font-size:.65rem;opacity:.5;}

    /* ── CONTACT SECTION ── */
    .contact-section{padding:0 6% 100px;}
    .contact-wrap{max-width:1300px;margin:0 auto;}

    /* Quick cards — all scroll to form */
    .quick-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:64px;}
    .qcard{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);padding:32px 24px 28px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
      transition:all .35s var(--ease);cursor:pointer;
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;
      opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .5s var(--ease) forwards;
    }
    .qcard:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.1s;}
    .qcard:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s;}
    .qcard:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s;}
    .qcard::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--grad-soft);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s ease;}
    .qcard:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:var(--border-hi);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}
    .qcard:hover::before{opacity:1;}
    .qcard-shimmer{position:absolute;top:0;left:-100%;width:50%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.06),transparent);transform:skewX(-15deg);pointer-events:none;}
    .qcard:hover .qcard-shimmer{animation:shimmer .7s ease forwards;}
    /* Scroll hint label at top of each card */
    .qcard-hint{
      position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
      padding:3px 11px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
      background:rgba(64,207,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.22);
      font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
      color:var(--cyan);white-space:nowrap;z-index:2;
    }
    .qcard-hint i{font-size:.6rem;}
    .qcard-icon{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.4rem;position:relative;z-index:1;transition:transform .3s ease;}
    .qcard:hover .qcard-icon{transform:scale(1.1) translateY(-3px);}
    .qcard-wa .qcard-icon{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#16a34a,#0f7337);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(22,163,74,.30);color:#fff;}
    .qcard-em .qcard-icon{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#5930d6,#7B5CFF);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(123,92,255,.30);color:#fff;}
    .qcard-panel .qcard-icon{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0891b2,#0e7490);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(6,182,212,.30);color:#fff;}
    .qcard-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .qcard-value{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .qcard-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 13px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .badge-wa{background:rgba(37,211,102,.15);border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.25);color:#6ee7b7;}
    .badge-em{background:rgba(123,92,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(123,92,255,.25);color:#c4b5fd;}
    .badge-panel{background:rgba(6,182,212,.15);border:1px solid rgba(6,182,212,.25);color:#67e8f9;}
    .live-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#34d399;box-shadow:0 0 6px #34d399;animation:blink 2s infinite;flex-shrink:0;}
    /* Arrow at bottom of card */
    .qcard-arrow{position:relative;z-index:1;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
    .qcard-arrow i{transition:transform .25s ease;}
    .qcard:hover .qcard-arrow i{transform:translateY(3px);}

    /* Main grid */
    .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:start;}

    /* Form card */
    .form-card{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
      background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04),rgba(255,255,255,.015));
      overflow:hidden;opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .6s .35s var(--ease) forwards;
      scroll-margin-top:80px;
    }
    /* Flash animation when scrolled to */
    .form-card.highlight{animation:flashHighlight 1.2s ease forwards;}
    .form-card-head{padding:24px 28px 20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(123,92,255,.10),rgba(240,64,200,.06));border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);}
    .form-card-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .form-card-sub{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;}
    /* Active subject banner shown when arriving from a card click */
    .form-intent-banner{
      display:none;padding:11px 18px;
      background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(64,207,255,.10),rgba(123,92,255,.08));
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.18);
      font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);line-height:1.5;
      align-items:center;gap:10px;
    }
    .form-intent-banner.show{display:flex;}
    .form-intent-banner i{color:var(--cyan);flex-shrink:0;}
    .form-body{padding:28px;}
    .form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
    .form-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px;}
    .form-label{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}
    .req{color:#f87171;margin-left:2px;}
    .form-input,.form-select,.form-textarea{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:var(--r-md);color:#fff;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;outline:none;transition:all .25s ease;-webkit-appearance:none;}
    .form-input,.form-select{height:46px;padding:0 16px;}
    .form-textarea{padding:14px 16px;resize:vertical;min-height:130px;line-height:1.6;}
    .form-input::placeholder,.form-textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted);}
    .form-select option{background:#0E1128;color:#fff;}
    .form-input:focus,.form-select:focus,.form-textarea:focus{border-color:rgba(123,92,255,.50);background:rgba(123,92,255,.07);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(123,92,255,.10);}
    .form-input.error{border-color:rgba(248,113,113,.50);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(248,113,113,.10);}
    .form-error-msg{font-size:.68rem;color:#f87171;margin-top:3px;display:none;}
    .form-error-msg.show{display:block;}
    /* Subject */
    .subject-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;}
    .subject-opt{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);cursor:pointer;transition:all .22s ease;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
    .subject-opt:hover{border-color:rgba(123,92,255,.30);background:rgba(123,92,255,.07);}
    .subject-opt.selected{border-color:rgba(123,92,255,.50);background:rgba(123,92,255,.10);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(123,92,255,.20);}
    .subject-opt i{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);width:14px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;}
    .subject-opt.selected i{color:var(--violet);}
    .subject-opt-label{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--soft);font-weight:500;}
    .subject-opt.selected .subject-opt-label{color:#fff;}
    /* Submit */
    .submit-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;}
    .form-submit{flex:1;min-width:150px;height:52px;border-radius:var(--r-md);border:none;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;transition:all .3s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
    .form-submit-wa{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#1da851,#25D366);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(37,211,102,.22);}
    .form-submit-wa:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(37,211,102,.32);}
    .form-submit-em{background:var(--grad);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(123,92,255,.25);}
    .form-submit-em:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(240,64,200,.28);}
    .form-submit.loading{pointer-events:none;opacity:.7;}
    .spinner{width:18px;height:18px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite;display:none;}
    .form-submit.loading .spinner{display:block;}
    .form-submit.loading .btn-txt,.form-submit.loading .btn-ic{display:none;}
    /* Success */
    .form-success{display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:16px;padding:48px 28px;}
    .form-success.show{display:flex;}
    .form-success-icon{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(52,211,153,.2),rgba(64,207,255,.15));border:2px solid rgba(52,211,153,.35);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.8rem;animation:pulseRing 2s ease-in-out 3;}
    .form-success-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;}
    .form-success-sub{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;max-width:34ch;}
    .form-success-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:var(--soft);font-size:.84rem;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s ease;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;}
    .form-success-back:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff;}

    /* Info panel */
    .info-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .6s .5s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .info-block{border-radius:var(--r-xl);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);overflow:hidden;}
    .info-block-head{padding:18px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
    .info-block-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.85rem;flex-shrink:0;}
    .info-block-head h3{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#fff;}
    .info-block-body{padding:18px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
    .cinfo-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);transition:all .25s ease;text-decoration:none;}
    .cinfo-item:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);transform:translateX(4px);}
    .cinfo-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.85rem;flex-shrink:0;}
    .cinfo-label{font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px;}
    .cinfo-val{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--soft);font-weight:500;}
    .hours-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);}
    .hours-day{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);}
    .hours-time{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);font-weight:500;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;}
    .resp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
    .resp-item{padding:14px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);text-align:center;}
    .resp-time{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .resp-label{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;}
    .map-card{border-radius:var(--r-xl);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);overflow:hidden;}
    .map-inner{height:180px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.08),rgba(123,92,255,.10),rgba(240,64,200,.07));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;}
    .map-grid-lines{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:32px 32px;}
    .map-pin{position:relative;z-index:1;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.3rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(123,92,255,.15),0 0 0 32px rgba(123,92,255,.07);animation:pulseRing 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;}

    .map-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:2px;}
    .map-sub{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted);}

    .faq-teaser-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px;}

    .faq-teaser-sub{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.7;max-width:44ch;}
    .faq-teaser-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:52px;padding:0 28px;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--grad);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(123,92,255,.28);transition:all .3s ease;flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap;}
    .faq-teaser-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(240,64,200,.28);}

    .footer-brand-name span{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .footer-brand-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;margin-bottom:14px;max-width:26ch;line-height:1.5;}
    .footer-contact-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
    .footer-contact-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-md);font-size:.76rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s ease;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;}
    .footer-wa{background:rgba(37,211,102,.10);border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.22);color:#6ee7b7;}
    .footer-wa:hover{background:rgba(37,211,102,.18);border-color:rgba(37,211,102,.40);}
    .footer-em{background:rgba(123,92,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(123,92,255,.22);color:#c4b5fd;}

    .footer-links-group{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;}
    .footer-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
    .footer-col-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--soft);margin-bottom:4px;}

    .footer-bottom{padding:20px 0 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}

function scrollToForm(e, subject){
  if(e) e.preventDefault();

  // Pre-select the right subject button
  document.querySelectorAll('.subject-opt').forEach(function(o){ o.classList.remove('selected'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.subject-opt').forEach(function(o){
    if(o.querySelector('.subject-opt-label').textContent.trim() === subject){
      o.classList.add('selected');
    }
  });

  // Show intent banner with context message
  var msgs = {
    'Technical Support': '🔧 You selected Technical Support — fill the form and choose "Send via WhatsApp" for the fastest response.',
    'General Question':  '💬 You selected General Question — fill the form and send via WhatsApp or Email below.',

    'Reseller Inquiry':  '🏪 You selected Reseller Inquiry — fill the form and we\'ll get back to you within minutes.'
  };
  var banner = document.getElementById('intentBanner');
  document.getElementById('intentText').textContent = msgs[subject] || msgs['General Question'];
  banner.classList.add('show');

  // Scroll smoothly to form
  var card = document.getElementById('contact-form');

  // Flash highlight animation on the card
  setTimeout(function(){
    card.classList.remove('highlight');
    void card.offsetWidth; // reflow
    card.classList.add('highlight');
    setTimeout(function(){ card.classList.remove('highlight'); }, 1300);
  }, 400);

  // Focus first name field after scroll
  setTimeout(function(){
    var fn = document.getElementById('fName');
    if(fn) fn.focus();

}

  document.getElementById('selectedSubject').value = val;
}

/* ══ Validator ══ */
function isEmail(s){ return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(s); }

/* ══ Collect & validate ══ */
function collectAndValidate(){
  var name    = document.getElementById('fName').value.trim();
  var lname   = document.getElementById('lName').value.trim();
  var email   = document.getElementById('cEmail').value.trim();
  var phone   = document.getElementById('cPhone').value.trim();
  var country = document.getElementById('cCountry').value;
  var msg     = document.getElementById('cMessage').value.trim();
  var subject = document.getElementById('selectedSubject').value;

  ['fName','cEmail','cMessage'].forEach(function(id){
    document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('error');
    document.getElementById('err-'+id).classList.remove('show');
  });

  var ok=true;
  if(!name){document.getElementById('fName').classList.add('error');document.getElementById('err-fName').classList.add('show');ok=false;}
  if(!email||!isEmail(email)){document.getElementById('cEmail').classList.add('error');document.getElementById('err-cEmail').classList.add('show');ok=false;}
  if(!msg){document.getElementById('cMessage').classList.add('error');document.getElementById('err-cMessage').classList.add('show');ok=false;}
  if(!ok) return null;

  return {fullname:name+(lname?' '+lname:''),email:email,phone:phone,country:country,msg:msg,subject:subject};
}
